posts.author: EricWilsonTSBC
posts.body:
SSIA: Vanguard Chronicles is a story-rich, gacha-based 2D turn-based RPG developed by the TSBC Games Division using RPG Maker VX Ace. Set in the gritty and politically complex world of the Sierra Secret Investigation Agency (SSIA), you play as a once-elite agent who lost everything in a ruthless ambush—your power, your weapons, your future.
Now, awakened from the brink of death and driven by vengeance, duty, and mystery, you must reclaim your elemental gemstones, uncover the truth behind the betrayal, and step back into a world that may no longer remember the hero you once were.
Featuring strategic turn-based combat, seven elemental types (Pyro, Hydro, Electro, Cryro, Geo, Spectro, and Void), and deep lore rooted in the SSIA universe, Vanguard Chronicles invites players into a world of shifting alliances, hidden threats, and choices that shape destinies.
Whether you're unraveling conspiracies at SSIA Headquarters, training under skilled agents like Fritz, or forging your path through the capital city Bellemaire, every battle, every dialogue, and every decision matters.

posts.author: EricWilsonTSBC
posts.body:
Big News:
We have revised the battle systems, which previously required selecting an attack from the Attack Options. Additionally, I have incorporated more skill types into the RPG Maker VX Ace's attack options to enhance functionality. These include:
- Basic (Standard attack type)
- Skills (Skill-based attack type)
- Ultimate (Ultimate attack type)
So on battle menu ingame will be :
Basic
Skills
Ultimate
Items
Guard
Current Battle Menu:
Attack
Skills
Ultimate
Basic
Items
Guard
We are also revamping all the Game Systems from the Databases and adding New Skills, Weapons and other things, 1.1.0 Update will be Big and expect to be released as long as December 2025 no date yet
